title: Flying Swallow
body:
Syntax: flying swallow <target>

Description: A chakra-extended sword or kunai strike with +15 accuracy and a chance to cause bleeding. Wind chakra nature adds 15% damage but is optional. Requires a wielded sword or kunai. Base damage: 203-235. 30% chance to inflict bleeding. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 45. Costs 30 Chakra and 18 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
